SELECT derivative(max_in_window, 1s)*8 as "Mbs" FROM
(
SELECT max("value") AS max_in_window 
FROM "default_collectd_retention"."interface_rx" WHERE ("host"::tag =~ /^$host$/ AND "type"::tag = 'if_octets') AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(30s), "instance"::tag, "host"::tag fill(null)
) 
GROUP BY "instance"::tag, "host"::tag

SELECT derivative(max_in_window, 1s)*8 as "Mbs" FROM
(
SELECT max("value") AS max_in_window 
FROM "default_collectd_retention"."interface_tx" WHERE ("host"::tag =~ /^$host$/ AND "type"::tag = 'if_octets') AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time(30s), "instance"::tag, "host"::tag fill(null)
) 
GROUP BY "instance"::tag, "host"::tag
